summary: Port the complete native analytic narrow-phase first pass, primitive projections, cuboid SAT/clipping and material combination.
regressions: 37 live native Rust fixture groups cover dispatch/grid strides, all analytic shape pairs, same-body/deferred slots, interior/axis/boundary/separated contacts, both shape orders, rotations, all material-rule pairs, degenerate capsules and box clipping/reduction.
Geometry-aware fault injection accepts valid alternative axial contacts but rejects off-surface/nonclosest points, wrong normals, material changes, IDs, inactive writes and malformed inputs.
Repeated oracle export preserves runtime outputs and a fixed explicit input ABI.
Current source matrix includes shared Rust capsule fix 0029; old invalid capsule surface points are rejected rather than blessed as float drift.
differences: Symmetry direction can differ for near-axis ball/capsule/cone/cylinder contacts; both results must be valid closest surface points with consistent unit normals. Existing separation/material tolerance is unchanged.
Three-index/dynamic local arrays preserve Rust point/candidate order without claiming the same register allocation or performance.
Signed local shape tags avoid a TileLang unsigned negative-bound analysis failure. Full u32 material rules are widened to signed 64 bits for comparisons without changing unknown-rule behavior.
C magnitude comparisons avoid bitcasts of float literals (an address-of-rvalue codegen failure); box execution regressions cover the path.
No CPU geometry fallback, generic convex/PFM claim, production full-frame claim or Ascend hardware claim.
